custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

Staging only (QA lead, 23 Oct 2026): run this test on staging. Production always keeps a technician's staff record name and sign-in name the same, so the person this test needs cannot exist there.

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A} on staging, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.

    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.

  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A}, and the name on their staff record differs from the name on their login account. Settings > Staff shows the login account name; the technician lists on a work order show the staff record name.

    For example (staging, seen 21 Oct 2026): the staff record reads David Sparks and the login account reads Carol Neal; or the staff record reads Debra Garcia and the login account reads Lindsay Perez.

  • Work order {Work-order-1} is Approved, led by {Technician-A}, and has one approved line, {Line-1}, with {Technician-A} as its technician.

    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-37765, led by David Sparks, with one approved line he works on.

  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on its "Lines" tab.

  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
